title: New Pants for the Trip
setting: A cosy house with a living room and a small bathroom.

characters.name: Lily
characters.look: Lily, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow shirt

characters.name: Grandmother
characters.look: Grandmother, an old woman with grey hair and glasses

sentences.en: Lily is at home with her grandmother.
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow shirt and Grandmother, an old woman with grey hair and glasses sit together on a sofa in a cosy living room.

sentences.en: A calendar with flowers is on the wall.
sentences.zh: 墙上挂着一本印着花的日历。
sentences.scene_prompt: A calendar decorated with flowers hangs on a living room wall.

sentences.en: Lily's next school trip is on that date.
sentences.zh: 莉莉下一次学校出游就在那一天。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow shirt points at a circled day on the flower calendar, Grandmother, an old woman with grey hair and glasses watching.

sentences.en: The student needs some new pants for it.
sentences.zh: 这个学生需要几条新裤子去出游。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow shirt holds up old short pants that are too small for her, looking at Grandmother, an old woman with grey hair and glasses.

sentences.en: Grandmother holds two pairs of pants on her arm.
sentences.zh: 奶奶手臂上搭着两条裤子。
sentences.scene_prompt: Grandmother, an old woman with grey hair and glasses holds a pair of blue pants and a pair of green pants over her arm.

sentences.en: Lily cannot decide which pair she likes more.
sentences.zh: 莉莉拿不定主意更喜欢哪一条。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow shirt looks back and forth between the blue pants and the green pants.

sentences.en: She goes to the toilet to try them on.
sentences.zh: 她走进洗手间去试穿这两条裤子。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow shirt carries the blue pants into a small bathroom with a toilet.

sentences.en: They are very long, but Grandmother finds a way.
sentences.zh: 裤子太长了，但奶奶想到了办法。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow shirt wears blue pants that cover her feet while Grandmother, an old woman with grey hair and glasses kneels and rolls up the legs.
